page: Google Cloud Platform n2-highcpu-2 is a compute-oriented virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 2 vCPUs provisioned from 1 physical Intel Xeon core running at a base clock speed of 2.8 GHz with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system features 2.0 GB of memory, resulting in a 1.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside a 33 MB L3 cache. Supported hardware extensions include AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES cryptography, and BMI2. This server instance does not include integrated GPUs or attached local NVMe storage.

Benchmark evaluations reflect the entry-level compute profile of the instance. In synthetic processor workloads, it recorded a stress-ng single-core score of 1399.29 and a multi-core score of 1841.88. Geekbench results produced a single-core score of 1111.0 and a multi-core score of 1311.0. Potentially uncached memory bandwidth reached 13.72 GB/sec for read operations and 11.78 GB/sec for write operations. Small model language processing achieved 116.03 prompt processing tokens per second on a 135M parameter LLM.

The low RAM-to-vCPU ratio offers qualitative cost efficiency for execution pipelines that rely on processor threads rather than memory capacity. The instance faces memory performance trade-offs under high-concurrency or data-heavy workloads. The n2-highcpu-2 instance is best suited for lightweight CPU-bound workloads, entry-level microservices, small automated scripts, static web serving, and basic build tasks.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-highcpu-2 is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual machine powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon processor. It offers 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyperthreading, paired with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low 1.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The architecture includes 33 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 and AES encryption acceleration. The server includes no attached local storage or GPUs. Benchmark testing places its execution capacity in lower tiers, with a single-core Geekbench score of 1111.0 and multi-core score of 1311.0, along with static web serving throughput of 2.06 GB/sec. Given its low memory footprint and dedicated compute allocation, n2-highcpu-2 provides a specialized hardware profile suited for small compute-bound tasks, simple web microservices, and lightweight batch processing where high RAM capacity is unnecessary.
